# SMP: Studints Manager Project Sofrware

Description:
-

This Sofrware to Manager Studints and Teachers and their classes with their courses and their marks and their grades and their absences and their attendances.
-

Install :
-
- `SMP` is a `Python` based project.

- ###  Linux :
  - `sudo apt-get install python3`
  - `sudo apt-get install python3-pip`
  - `git clone https://github.com/Yazan-Dev9/Students_Manager-SMP`
  - `cd SMP/`
  - `python3 setup.py`

---

-
- `0.0.1_alpha` _ `0.0.1_alpha_GUI`
